v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Proprio de Tempore

text.la: Unus mílitum * láncea latus eius apéruit et contínuo exívit sanguis et aqua.
text.en: One of the soldiers * with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out Blood and Water.

text.la: Stans Iesus * clamábat dicens: Si quis sitit, véniat ad me et bibat.
text.en: Jesus stood * and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me and drink.

text.la: In caritáte perpétua * diléxit nos Deus, ídeo, exaltátus a terra, attráxit nos ad Cor suum, míserans.
text.en: With an everlasting love * hath God loved us, and from the day that he was lifted up over the earth, he hath drawn us with loving-kindness unto his Heart.

text.la: Veníte ad me * omnes qui laborátis et oneráti estis et ego refíciam vos.
text.en: Come unto me, * all ye that travail and are heavy laden, and I will refresh you.

text.la: Fili, * præbe mihi cor tuum, et óculi tui custódiant vias meas.
text.en: My son, * give me thine heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways.

text.la: Fratres: Mihi ómnium sanctórum mínimo data est grátia hæc, in géntibus evangelizáre investigábiles divítias Christi; et illumináre omnes, quæ sit dispensátio sacraménti abscónditi a sǽculis in Deo.
text.en: Brethren: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ; and to make all men see what is the fellowship of the Mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God.

v.en: With joy shall ye draw water.

r.en: Out of the fountains of the Saviour.

text.la: Ad Iesum autem * cum veníssent, ut vidérunt eum iam mórtuum, non fregérunt eius crura, sed unus mílitum láncea latus eius apéruit et contínuo exívit sanguis et aqua.
text.en: But when they came to Jesus * and saw that he was dead already, they broke not his legs, but one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out Blood and Water.

text.la: Deus, qui nobis in Corde Fílii tui, nostris vulneráto peccátis, infinítos dilectiónis thesáuros misericórditer largíri dignáris; concéde, quǽsumus, ut illi devótum pietátis nostræ præstántes obséquium, dignæ quoque satisfactiónis exhibeámus offícium.
text.en: O God, who hast suffered the Heart of thy Son to be wounded by our sins, and in that very Heart hast bestowed on us the abundant riches of thy love: grant that the devout homage of our hearts, which we render unto him, may of thy mercy be deemed a recompence acceptable in thy sight.

office.title: Sacratissimi Cordis Domini Nostri Jesu Christi
